text:
anu: Heads-up: security wants to tighten keystore privatelink ACLs in eu-west-2 at 04:00 UTC tomorrow. They mentioned potential impact on onboarding/warmup traffic.
ops-bot: Scheduled change CHG-20241205-412 by @security: keystore-privatelink-deny-default-euw2 at 2024-12-05T04:00Z.
leo: Which subnets talk to those endpoints? warmpool uses 10.22.16.0/22, spot-onboard is 10.22.20.0/24.
mina: If blocked we'll get keystore 403 during handshake and kube join retries spike. Last similar event added ~20-30% warmup time.
anu: Quick mitigations proposed: 1) temporary allowlist for those CIDRs via TF toggle, TTL 3h; 2) 2-node canary before security flips ACL; 3) adjust readiness to fail faster to avoid long retry loops.
leo: +1. Can we make the allowlist change conditional on canary health? i.e., apply, run canary, then let security proceed.
mina: I'll prepare TF branch `sec/keystore-temp-allow-euw2` with `allowlist_ttl = "3h"`. PR ready -> https://git.company/infra/pull/899.
ops-bot: Temporary channel created: #temp/keystore-privatelink-euw2.
anu: Monitoring: add alarm keystore_handshake_5xx > 3% for 5m, and warmup_latency > baseline + 15% for 10m. Tie to cost-ops.
cost-ops: noted. Cost hit estimate: 5-9% uplift for AZ during window due to longer warmpool runtime. We'll auto-pause large-scale warmups if warmed nodes exceed baseline +30%.
leo: Preflight test: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "X-Node: canary" https://keystore-proxy.internal/handshake` should return 200 from a warmpool bastion. Run at 03:30 UTC.
mina: Readiness probe change ready. We'll set NotReady after 3 handshake failures (was 10).
anu: Action items: @mina open PR, @leo run preflight 03:30, @cost-ops configure auto-pause, @anu hold rollback authority. Be on standby 03:15-04:15 UTC.
leo: Will tail logs during canary: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gpu-join --follow`.
mina: Canary runbook: apply allowlist -> deploy 2 canary nodes -> run handshake -> monitor 15m -> if green remove allowlist TTL to let security proceed.
anu: If any metric breaches, rollback ACL and notify security to exclude onboarding CIDRs.
ops-bot: Change watchers: anu, leo, mina.
